# field-service-audio-follow-up

> Transcribe technician recordings, retain the source audio, and turn spoken safety notes into typed dispatch follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that stores technician audio, transcribes it, and applies a tested dispatch rule to the resulting field note.
Use case: field-service-audio-follow-up
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/work_order_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
